plan.phasesIntro: The product is delivered in phases. Each phase ends with something people can use. Only phase 1 is broken down further.
plan.milestonesIntro: Phase 1 is delivered in six milestones. A milestone is a point where the build can be shown working. Each has a goal and an exit check; it is done when the exit check passes, not when its tickets are closed. Under each milestone are its intents: the outcomes it delivers, each to be written up as an `intent.md` and then a `spec.md`.
notes: After M3 two browsers can chat for real. That is the earliest point worth putting on a test server for daily use by a few people.
Seed data (TOKI-081) is built at the end of M3 rather than in M6, so that from then on a reset can be followed by `dev:seed` to get people, channels and messages to work with.
M1 comes before M2 so that every later screen is assembled from components that already match the prototype.
The job queue ticket (TOKI-064) sits at the start of M4 because status timers, thumbnails and link previews need it.
The intent list is a draft. Intents I16 and I17 were added on request; each has one ticket by decision.
plan.ticketsIntro: Within each milestone, tickets are grouped by work area. Codes in the Scope column (NR, OQ, G, F) point to rules, review answers, assumptions and flows in the other tabs. The last column lists questions that remain for the spec. Sizes compare tickets with each other: S about half a working session with Claude, M about one, L several.

roadmap.outro: Only phase 1 has a detailed plan. Each later phase is brainstormed on its own when its turn comes, starting from the requirements already recorded for it in Questions & Gaps and in the outline flows.

sections.title: How to read these flows
sections.intro: 19 charts cover phase 1: 2 high-level, 14 detailed, 3 for errors and edge cases. Detailed charts have three lanes: what the **user** does, what the **frontend** shows, and what the **backend** does, including the API request. The flows by role further down remain the written, step-by-step reference.

head: Shape
Meaning
rows: End: where the flow finishes well
A step: something done, shown or stored
A decision; every answer has its own arrow
A screen state: loading, empty, disabled, waiting
An error or a refusal, with what the person can do next
Going back: retry, correct, pick again

blocks.text: **Checked by script on every build:** 317 steps and 59 decisions; every decision has at least two answers drawn, every step is reachable from a start, and no step stops without being an end or a refusal page that says so.

blocks.caption: Thick outline: an entry point. Diamond: a check. Red: a refusal. Each box on the right continues in a detailed flow of section 2.

items: **Entry points (4):** the Toki address, a link to a conversation or message (from a notification, a mail or a colleague), the installed app icon, and the invitation mail.
**One gate:** every way in passes the session check. Nothing in Toki is readable without a session; there is no public page besides sign-in.
**Role check:** Admin is the only section gated by role. Everything else is gated by membership of the conversation, checked on the server for every request.

**In the prototype:** It opens straight into Home as Lan, an Owner. There is no sign-in, invitation, welcome or refusal page for members. The only sign-in screens belong to the guest portal (phase 5; demo guide → 'View as guest'): an email step, then a code step that says 'It works for 10 minutes'. Ctrl K exists: the Search box at the top of the left sidebar carries the label 'Ctrl K', and the keys open the command palette. Admin exists in the left navigation but holds only analytics and automations.

You confirmed: An invitation expires after 7 days. The link in the invitation signs the person in directly, without a code.
The prototype has no sign-in screen for members, only the guest one. How do members sign in, and how are accounts created? (Q11)

You chose the recommended option: As in the capability table under Roles & States
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-13):** A member's sign-in code is valid for 10 minutes.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-15):** A session renews on every use, so 30 days means 30 days without opening Toki.

blocks.caption: Filled pill: where the person ends up.

items: Only **Sign out** and **deactivation** end the session on purpose. Closing the tab never does.
Losing the connection is not an exit: the person stays on the same screen, read-only, until it returns (flow 3.1).

**In the prototype:** Sign out is not in the prototype. The account menu holds Set status, Pause notifications, Focus time and Preferences only (finding N-04). There are no sessions, so 'Session ended' and 'Account deactivated' do not exist either. Offline is a demo switch.

**Rule NR13** (made from GAP-21 · OQ11): When the connection drops: loaded content stays readable; messages being sent wait and send themselves when the connection returns; every other action is blocked with an explanation, never a false success.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-16):** Every screen and every wording in quotes that the prototype does not contain is a proposal: 'Session ended', 'Account deactivated', 'Not found or no access', 'Not sent', 'Can't reach Toki', loading placeholders, and the rest.

blocks.caption: Happy path runs down the middle; every refusal returns to a screen where the person can act.

items: **Before:** the address belongs to an active member; this device has no valid session.
**After:** a 30-day session on this device only; the code can never be used again; the app opens where the person was heading.

**Validation:** email must look like an address before the button enables. Code: exactly 6 digits, one use. Valid 10 minutes and cancelled after 5 wrong tries are assumptions (FA-13, FA-14). At most 5 code requests per address in 15 minutes (G5).
**Back / cancel / retry:** 'Use a different email' returns to the email field. 'Resend code' enables after 60 seconds. A network failure re-enables the button with 'Could not connect'.
**Alternative:** the mail also has a sign-in button. Pressing it signs in the device where it is pressed and skips typing the code.
**Security rule:** the answer to a code request is identical for members and strangers, so the page never reveals who is a member.

**In the prototype:** No member sign-in. The nearest screens are the guest portal's: 'Sign in as a guest' (email, 'Email me a code') and 'Check your email' (6-digit field, 'Sign in', 'Use a different email', 'It works for 10 minutes'). That screen has **no Resend**, no limit on requests and no wrong-code state (any 6 digits work). Its two errors show in a red line under the card.

blocks.title: Sources
items: The prototype has no sign-in screen for members, only the guest one. How do members sign in, and how are accounts created? (Q11)
You chose the recommended option: (b) 6-digit emailed code, no password, admin invitation only, 30-day session
How often may a sign-in code be requested, and when can it be sent again? (G5)
You confirmed: At most 5 code requests per email in 15 minutes; the resend button enables after 60 seconds.
**Technical design:** A code request is answered the same way for members and strangers, so the page never reveals who is a member.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-13):** A member's sign-in code is valid for 10 minutes.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-14):** A code is cancelled after 5 wrong tries; the person asks for a new one.

items: **Before:** an Admin or Owner sent an invitation to this address (flow 2.12).
**After:** the member is Active, in #general with its full history, signed in on this device; the link no longer works; #general shows 'X joined'.
**Validation:** display name 1 to 80 characters (your answer, Q31). Time zone and language come from the device and can be changed.
**Skip:** the welcome step can be skipped; the name becomes the part of the address before @.
**Next:** a small card asks whether to turn on notifications.
**In the prototype:** Nothing. The only invitation in the prototype is 'Invite a client' for guests, in a channel's Details panel. There is no welcome step and no refusal page.

You chose the recommended option: (b) 6-digit emailed code, no password, admin invitation only, 30-day session
A fresh installation has no accounts. How does the first Owner come to exist? (Q26)
Your answer: Created from environment variables or seed; that admin invites members
How long does an invitation last, and does its link need a sign-in code? (G4)
You confirmed: An invitation expires after 7 days. The link in the invitation signs the person in directly, without a code.
Which channel does everyone start in, and can it be left? (G1)
You confirmed: Every workspace has a #general channel created at setup; every member is in it automatically; it cannot be left or archived.
How long may a display name be? The flow for accepting an invitation checked '1 to 80 characters' without a decision behind it. (Q31)
Your answer: 1 to 80 characters

blocks.caption: Runs every time the page loads, whichever entry point was used.

items: **Before:** none. This is where every entry point lands.
**After:** the sidebar, unread counts and one conversation are on screen, and the realtime connection is open.
**Loading:** the app frame appears at once with grey placeholders for the lists; real content replaces them.
**Rule:** a link to something the person may not see answers exactly like a link to something that does not exist.
**Rule:** with no link, the app opens the conversation last viewed on this device; the very first time, #general.
**In the prototype:** Everything is in memory, so the app appears at once. There are no placeholders, no 'Can't reach Toki', and the address does not change with the screen (findings N-05, N-13).

blocks.title: Sources
items: Which conversation does the app open on? (G2)
You confirmed: The app opens on the conversation last viewed on that device; the first time, on #general.
The prototype has no sign-in screen for members, only the guest one. How do members sign in, and how are accounts created? (Q11)
You chose the recommended option: (b) 6-digit emailed code, no password, admin invitation only, 30-day session
**Technical design:** 'Not found' and 'no access' get the same answer, so the app never confirms that a private thing exists.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-02):** A request with no answer after 10 seconds counts as failed and shows Retry.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-16):** Every screen and every wording in quotes that the prototype does not contain is a proposal: 'Session ended', 'Account deactivated', 'Not found or no access', 'Not sent', 'Can't reach Toki', loading placeholders, and the rest.

blocks.caption: What clears an unread badge, and what does not.

items: **Before:** signed in; a member of the conversation, or it is a public channel being previewed.
**After:** the read pointer sits on the newest message seen; the badge is cleared on every device of this person. Nobody else is told (no 'seen' receipts).
**Rule:** a conversation is marked read only when its newest message is on screen and the tab has focus. Opening it in a background tab changes nothing.
**Older messages:** scrolling up loads 50 more with a spinner at the top and keeps the scroll position; at the start a 'Beginning of #name' marker shows.
**Load failure:** the message area shows 'Couldn't load messages' with Retry; the sidebar keeps working (flow 3.3).
**Preview:** a public channel the person has not joined is readable; the composer is replaced by a Join button.
**In the prototype:** Home: the conversation list, the message list, unread badges and the 'New' divider exist. There is no loading state and no failure state.

blocks.title: Sources
items: What marks a channel as read on Web and Phone, and when does the New divider clear? (OQ3)

Answer: Read state never depends on AI. A conversation is read when it is open, the window is in use, and the person is at the bottom of the list. The New divider anchors to the first unread message at the time of opening (by ID, so it does not drift), stays while viewing, and is gone the next time the conversation opens. Opening the app or a conversation with unread messages scrolls to the divider.
Does a sender see who has read a message? (G15)
You confirmed: Toki has no 'seen' receipts; a sender does not know who has read a message.
What do people who join a channel later see of its history, and what happens to a channel that is no longer used? (Q27)
You chose the recommended option: Full history; channels are archived, never deleted

**Rule NR8** (made from GAP-29, 31, 33): Every searchable or filterable list has an empty state centred in the content area and written for that context. A count on a chip always equals the rows shown.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-16):** Every screen and every wording in quotes that the prototype does not contain is a proposal: 'Session ended', 'Account deactivated', 'Not found or no access', 'Not sent', 'Can't reach Toki', loading placeholders, and the rest.

blocks.caption: The message shows before the server answers; the same message ID makes a retry safe.

items: **Before:** a member of the conversation; it is not archived; the composer holds 1 to 10,000 characters or at least one uploaded file.
**After:** one message stored exactly once; every member's unread count rises except the sender's; mentions become Activity items (flow 2.7); the draft is cleared on all devices.
**Disabled:** Send does nothing while the text is empty or only spaces, is locked past 10,000 characters (a counter appears near the limit), and while a file is still uploading.
**Keys:** Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a new line; while composing a Vietnamese word, Enter finishes the word and does not send.
**Retry:** 'Not sent' offers Retry and Delete. Retry resends the same ID, so a message that did arrive is never doubled.
**Leaving mid-way:** switching conversation before sending keeps the text as a draft, synced to other devices.

**In the prototype:** The composer and Send exist. With the demo offline switch on, a sent message appears faded with 'Waiting to send'. **'Not sent', Retry and Delete are not in the prototype** (the words do not occur in it), and there is no character counter.

You confirmed: A message holds up to 10,000 characters and 10 files.
**Rule NR11** (made from GAP-17 · OQ8): Writing to a conversation (sending, starting a Meet, scheduling) requires membership. Pickers list only conversations you have joined.

**Rule NR13** (made from GAP-21 · OQ11): When the connection drops: loaded content stays readable; messages being sent wait and send themselves when the connection returns; every other action is blocked with an explanation, never a false success.
**Technical design:** The app creates the message ID, so sending the same message again cannot create a second one.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-02):** A request with no answer after 10 seconds counts as failed and shows Retry.

blocks.caption: Bytes go straight to storage; the API only hands out the permission to upload.

items: **Before:** a conversation the person can write to; online (uploading is blocked offline).
**After:** each file is stored once and attached to the message; it appears in the conversation's 'Files & links' tab and in Files; only people who can see the conversation can open it.
**Validation:** at most 10 files per message, 100 MB each. A refused file is named in the message; the others continue.
**Cancel:** × on a card stops that upload and removes the card. Deleting the whole draft removes every card.
**Loading:** a thumbnail that is not ready shows a placeholder of the right proportions, so the list does not jump.

**In the prototype:** The paperclip in the composer adds a finished sample file at once. There is no file picker, progress bar, limit or failure (finding N-07). The numbers 10 and 100 MB appear nowhere in the prototype.

blocks.caption: One mention, three possible ways of being told, depending on the recipient's state.

items: **Before:** the message was sent (flow 2.5) and contains @person, @channel or @here.
**After:** the recipient has one Activity item; it becomes done by itself once the message has been opened.
**Rule:** your own action never notifies you.
**Rule:** during Pause or Focus there is no toast, push or sound; badges still update, and one summary lists what arrived when it ends.

**Open:** a mention always gets through the 'Mentions only' level. Whether it gets through Mute is not decided (question GQ-01 on the Gap analysis tab); the chart shows the muted case as badge only until it is.
**Rule:** @channel in a channel of 20 or more people asks the sender to confirm first.
**Edit:** adding a mention by editing notifies the new person; removing one removes the earlier notification.

**In the prototype:** The @ button and the people picker are in the composer; Activity lists mentions; Pause and Focus time are in the account menu; Preferences has 'Notify me for @mentions even in muted channels'. Push and the recipient's side cannot be observed: only one person is simulated.

blocks.title: Sources
items: The prototype has desktop notifications, sound, missed-mention email, per-channel levels, mute, Pause and Focus time. Which of these are in phase 1? (Q16)
You chose the recommended option: Badges, Web Push, sound, per-channel level, mute, Pause, Focus time. Missed-mention email later

**Rule NR5** (made from GAP-20, 26 · OQ10): Your own action never notifies you. An Activity item becomes done on its own once the thing it asks for is done. Activity is newest first and has a filter chip for every kind of item.

**Rule NR6** (made from GAP-25, 38 · OQ14): During Pause or Focus time there is no toast, push or sound, including reminders you set yourself. Badges still update. When it ends, one summary lists what arrived. Starting Focus during Focus extends it rather than nesting; ending restores the earlier status.
What is the default notification level? (G13)
You confirmed: Default notification level: 'Mentions only' for channels, 'All messages' for DMs.
Who may edit a channel's topic and use @channel? (G8)
You confirmed: Any channel member can edit the topic and use @channel; in a channel of 20 or more people, @channel asks for confirmation first.
What does a push notification show? (G11)
You confirmed: A push notification shows the sender, the conversation and the start of the message.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-12):** A mention of someone who is not in the channel creates no notification; the sender is offered 'Add them'.

blocks.caption: The prototype has no way to create a channel; this chart follows written flow F20.

items: **Before:** signed in as Member, Admin or Owner.
**After:** the channel exists, the creator is its only member, it is open on screen and listed in the sidebar.
**Validation:** lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 80 characters, unique among all channels including archived ones. Public or private is chosen here and cannot be changed later.
**Cancel:** Cancel, Esc or the × asks 'Discard this channel?' if anything was typed; an outside click does nothing.
**Rule:** after creating, the screen shows the new thing.

**In the prototype:** **A channel cannot be created in the prototype.** The sidebar has a '#' icon and a '+ Browse channels' row; both open Browse channels, which has a search field and Join or Open per row, and nothing to create a channel (finding N-03).

blocks.title: Sources
items: The prototype shows Owner, Admin and ordinary members but no difference between them. Who is allowed to do what? (Q12)
You chose the recommended option: As in the capability table under Roles & States
What may a channel name contain, and can a channel switch between public and private? (G7)
You confirmed: Channel names: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, up to 80 characters, unique. Public cannot become private after creation, or the reverse.
**Rule NR4** (made from GAP-22 · OQ12): A form that has content does not close on an outside click; closing it by button asks whether to discard.
**Rule NR10** (made from GAP-13, 14, 38): After something is created, the screen shows it; if a filter would hide it, the filter changes.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-04):** Typing a space in a channel name turns it into a hyphen, and capitals into lowercase, instead of showing an error.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-05):** The uniqueness of a channel name includes archived channels.

blocks.caption: Leaving a public channel can be undone; leaving a private one cannot, so it asks first.

items: **Before (join):** the channel is public and not archived. Private channels are joined only by being added.
**After (join):** member with full history; 'X joined' line in the channel; toast 'Joined #name'.
**After (leave):** the channel leaves the sidebar; its unread and Activity items are cleared; 'X left' line in the channel.
**Rule:** #general cannot be left. A reversible action shows Undo for 5 seconds; an irreversible one asks for confirmation; never both.
**Empty and archived:** no match shows 'No channels match' and a Create button carrying the search text; archived channels are listed with a View button only.

**In the prototype:** Browse channels (search, Join, Open) exists. Leaving is in the Details panel: 'Leave channel', then 'Leave #name? You can rejoin from Browse channels.', then a toast with Undo, for public and private alike (finding N-09). Removing someone else from a channel does not exist.

blocks.title: Sources
items: Which channel does everyone start in, and can it be left? (G1)
You confirmed: Every workspace has a #general channel created at setup; every member is in it automatically; it cannot be left or archived.

**Rule NR3** (made from GAP-24 · OQ12): A reversible action happens at once and shows a toast with Undo for 5 seconds. An irreversible action, or one that affects other people, asks for confirmation and names its target. Never both for one action.
After leaving a private channel, can a member rejoin alone or do they need an invitation? (OQ2)

Answer: A member must invite them back. The leave confirmation says so; Undo is still offered for 5 seconds. Private channels never appear in Browse or Ctrl+K for outsiders. If the last member leaves, the channel is archived.
What do people who join a channel later see of its history, and what happens to a channel that is no longer used? (Q27)
You chose the recommended option: Full history; channels are archived, never deleted
Do Admins and Owners see and manage every conversation? (G14)
You confirmed: Admins and Owners do not automatically see private channels or DMs; deleting messages, removing people and archiving apply only where they are members.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-10):** Leaving a channel clears its unread count and its open Activity items for that person.

blocks.caption: Edit is free and quiet; delete is permanent, so it asks.

items: **Before:** the person is the author and the message is not deleted. There is no time limit.
**After (edit):** new text with '(edited)' beside the time; no history of earlier versions is kept.
**After (delete):** gone for everyone; attached files are removed from storage and from Files. A message with replies leaves a 'Message deleted' line and keeps its thread.
**Cancel:** Esc or Cancel leaves the message untouched. Save is disabled while the text is unchanged; saving an empty text offers Delete instead.
**Others:** Admins and Owners can delete other people's messages only in conversations they belong to; the author is told.

**In the prototype:** The More menu on your own message has Edit and Delete. Edit turns the text into a field with Save and Cancel and adds '(edited)'. Deleting a message with a thread removes every reply in the prototype.

items: **Before:** the person can read the message.
**After:** the item is in Later under 'In progress'; with a reminder, a job is scheduled for that time; ticking the box moves it to Completed.
**Validation:** a reminder time must be in the future; a choice that is already past is not offered.
**Undo:** saving and un-saving are instant and reversible from the same bookmark; the toast 'Saved for Later' has a View button.
**Rule:** a count on a chip always equals the rows shown, including rows whose message was deleted.
**Empty:** with nothing saved, Later shows a centred note on how to save a message.
**In the prototype:** The bookmark on a message, the Later section, 'Remind me' or 'Change' on each row with a menu of times, and 'Remind me about this' in the message menu all exist.

**Rule NR7** (made from GAP-12, 13, 16, 38): Dates and times: required fields cannot be left empty; where a future time is needed the past is rejected; the year is shown whenever it is not the current year; one format across the app; 'Invalid Date' never appears.

**Rule NR6** (made from GAP-25, 38 · OQ14): During Pause or Focus time there is no toast, push or sound, including reminders you set yourself. Badges still update. When it ends, one summary lists what arrived. Starting Focus during Focus extends it rather than nesting; ending restores the earlier status.

**Rule NR8** (made from GAP-29, 31, 33): Every searchable or filterable list has an empty state centred in the content area and written for that context. A count on a chip always equals the rows shown.

items: **Before:** signed in as Admin or Owner.
**After:** each new address has an 'Invited' row with its expiry date and an invitation mail on its way; nothing is created twice.
**Validation:** every entry must look like an address; duplicates inside the batch are merged.
**Authorization:** checked on the server for every admin request; hiding the menu item is not the check.
**Row actions:** Resend sends a fresh link and restarts the 7 days; Revoke asks for confirmation and kills the old link at once.
**Mail down:** the row says 'Mail not sent' and the server command for emergency access still works.

**In the prototype:** **Not in the prototype.** Admin (the shield in the left navigation) has two tabs, analytics and automations; there is no members table and no invitation for members (finding N-02). The only invitation dialog is 'Invite a client' for guests.

items: **Before:** signed in as Admin or Owner, on the Admin page.
**Who may do what:** only an Owner changes roles. An Admin deactivates Members; only an Owner deactivates Admins and Owners.
**Constraints:** nobody deactivates themselves; the last Owner cannot be demoted or deactivated.
**After (role):** the label updates on Admin, People and the profile; the person gets an Activity item and sees the Admin entry appear or disappear.

**After (deactivate):** every session ends; old messages stay with a 'Deactivated' label; the person leaves People, mention lists and add-people lists; DMs with them become read-only. Reactivate restores access to the same channels.
**Cancel:** closing the confirmation changes nothing.
**In the prototype:** **Not in the prototype.** Admin has no members table, so there is no role menu and no Deactivate (finding N-02). People and the profile panel show a role label, read-only.

You confirmed: There can be several Owners. The last Owner cannot be demoted or deactivated.

**Rule NR3** (made from GAP-24 · OQ12): A reversible action happens at once and shows a toast with Undo for 5 seconds. An irreversible action, or one that affects other people, asks for confirmation and names its target. Never both for one action.

items: **Before:** signed in as Member, Admin or Owner. Guests cannot start DMs.
**After:** the conversation is open. The other people see it in their list only once the first message is sent.
**Limit:** a group holds at most 8 people, counting the person who starts it. Nobody can be added or removed later; a different set of people is a new group.
**Same people, same conversation:** choosing a set of people that already has a conversation reopens it with its history.
**Deactivated person:** not listed in the picker; an existing DM with them stays readable, without a composer.

**In the prototype:** 'New message' is the pencil icon above the conversation list. Its dialog has one field, 'Search people and channels'; pressing a row opens that DM or channel at once. **Several people cannot be chosen**, so a group cannot be started. One group exists as sample data only: 'Alex, Thu', three people.

items: **Rule:** loaded content stays readable; messages being sent wait and send themselves; every other action is blocked with an explanation, never a false success.
**Catch-up:** the app remembers the number of the last event it saw and asks for everything after it. After more than 7 days away it reloads everything instead.
**No duplicates:** a waiting message is resent with its original ID.
**Banner:** it never covers the composer or the navigation.

**In the prototype:** A demo switch turns the network off. The prototype then shows a strip above the chat, 'Offline: showing saved messages · messages you send wait until you are back online', the same words above the conversation list, and 'Waiting to send' on messages. **'Reconnecting…' and 'Reconnected' are not in the prototype**, and other actions are not blocked (GAP-21).

blocks.title: Sources
items: **Rule NR13** (made from GAP-21 · OQ11): When the connection drops: loaded content stays readable; messages being sent wait and send themselves when the connection returns; every other action is blocked with an explanation, never a false success.
**Rule NR12** (made from GAP-03, 11): Toasts and floating bars never cover the composer or navigation.
**Technical design:** Every change is a numbered event. After reconnecting, the app asks for everything after the last number it saw; after more than 7 days away it reloads.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-06):** Reconnect attempts wait 1, 2, 5, 10 and then 30 seconds, with a little randomness.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-09):** A 'Waiting to send' message survives a page reload, kept in the browser, and is dropped if someone else signs in on that browser.
**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-17):** While offline the banner keeps the prototype's words, 'Offline: showing saved messages'. A separate 'Reconnecting…' state is not assumed.

items: **Before:** the app is open with a session that has just stopped being valid.
**After:** nothing of the workspace stays readable on screen; after signing in again the person is back in the same conversation with the draft still in the composer.
**Rule:** the server checks the session on every request and closes the realtime connection the moment a session ends.
**Rule:** a deactivated account gets no sign-in button, and its locally kept drafts are cleared.
**In the prototype:** **Not in the prototype.** It has no sign-in and no sessions, so none of these screens exist (finding N-01).

blocks.caption: Each answer from the server maps to exactly one thing the person sees. Every refusal leads back to a state where they can act.

items: **Disabled while waiting:** the control that started the request is disabled and shows a spinner, so nothing is submitted twice.
**Form kept:** a refusal never clears what the person typed.
**No access and not found look the same**, so the app never confirms that a private thing exists.
**Error ID:** a server error shows a short ID the person can pass on; the same ID is in the server log.
**401** is handled by flow 3.2 for every request.

**In the prototype:** **Not in the prototype.** There is no server; every action succeeds at once. The words 'error' and 'Retry' do not occur in it (finding N-06). Problems in forms are reported by a toast after pressing the button (finding N-08).

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-08):** Server status codes map to screens as in flow 3.3: 400 field message, 403 and 404 one shared page, 409 and 410 fresh copy, 429 wait, 5xx Retry with an error ID.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-16):** Every screen and every wording in quotes that the prototype does not contain is a proposal: 'Session ended', 'Account deactivated', 'Not found or no access', 'Not sent', 'Can't reach Toki', loading placeholders, and the rest.

blocks.text: Business rules (decided)

head: ID
Rule
Flows
Source
rows: Nothing in Toki is readable without a session. Sign-in is the only public page.
Sign-in is by a 6-digit code sent to the member's address. There is no password. How long a code lasts and how many wrong tries it allows are not decided: FA-13, FA-14.
At most 5 code requests per address in 15 minutes; Resend enables after 60 seconds.
A code request gets the same answer whether or not the address is a member.
A session lasts 30 days on one device. Whether it renews on use is not decided: FA-15.
People join only by invitation from an Admin or Owner. An invitation lasts 7 days, works once, and signs the person in without a code.
Every member is in #general; it cannot be left or archived.
With no link, the app opens the conversation last viewed on that device; the first time, #general.
Permission is checked on the server for every request. Private conversations and DMs are visible to members only, including through search, file lists and direct links.
'No access' and 'not found' are answered the same way.
Writing to a conversation requires membership, and the conversation must not be archived.
A message holds up to 10,000 characters and 10 files; a file up to 100 MB.
The app creates the message ID; sending the same ID again returns the stored message instead of a second one.
A conversation is marked read only when its newest message is on screen in a focused tab. There are no 'seen' receipts.
Your own action never notifies you. An Activity item becomes done on its own once the thing it asks for is done.
During Pause or Focus there is no toast, push or sound, including your own reminders; badges update; one summary follows.
Default notification level: 'Mentions only' for channels, 'All messages' for DMs.
@channel in a channel of 20 or more people asks the sender to confirm.
Channel names: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, up to 80 characters, unique. Public or private is fixed at creation.
A reversible action happens at once with Undo for 5 seconds; an irreversible one asks for confirmation and names its target; never both.
A form with content does not close on an outside click; closing it by button asks whether to discard.
After something is created the screen shows it; a filter that would hide it changes.
A private channel cannot be rejoined alone after leaving; the person must be added again.
Only the author edits a message; there is no time limit and no edit history. Deleting is permanent and removes the attached files.
A deleted message with replies leaves a 'Message deleted' line and keeps its thread.
Admins and Owners see and moderate only conversations they are members of.
Only an Owner changes roles. An Admin deactivates Members; only an Owner deactivates Admins and Owners.
Nobody deactivates themselves. The last Owner cannot be demoted or deactivated.
Deactivation ends every session at once; messages stay; the account can be reactivated. Nothing is deleted permanently in phase 1.
Offline: loaded content stays readable, messages wait and send themselves, every other action is blocked with an explanation.
After reconnecting the app receives every missed event in order; after more than 7 days away it reloads.
Every list has an empty state written for its context; a count on a chip equals the rows shown.
Toasts and banners never cover the composer or the navigation.
Every action has an entry point on narrow and touch screens; nothing is hover-only.
A display name is 1 to 80 characters.
A group DM holds at most 8 people, counting its creator. Nobody is added or removed afterwards.
Every Member, Admin and Owner may create public and private channels and start DMs and groups. Guests may not.
Only an Admin or Owner removes someone from a channel, and only in a channel they belong to themselves.

sections.title: 5 · Open questions and missing requirements
sections.intro: Cases the charts ran into that no decision, rule or written flow covers yet. Each has a suggested answer; none is assumed in the charts unless it says so.

head: ID
Question
Flows
Suggested answer
Blocks
rows: Someone is signed in as A and presses an invitation or sign-in link meant for B. Does the link replace A's session, or does the page ask first?
Ask first: 'You are signed in as A. Continue as B?'
Sign out in one tab: do the other tabs of the same browser leave at once?
Yes, at once; they share the session
An Admin invites the address of a deactivated member. Refuse, or offer Reactivate?
Refuse with 'This account is deactivated' and a Reactivate button
Are any file types refused (for example programs), or is every type accepted up to 100 MB?
Accept every type; always download, never run in the browser
A message is deleted while someone else is writing a reply in its thread. Is the reply still sent?
Yes; the thread stays under the 'Message deleted' line
'Today 15:00' in the reminder menu after 15:00: hidden, or replaced by another choice?
How long does a 'Waiting to send' message keep trying before it becomes 'Not sent'?
It waits while offline; once online, one automatic try, then 'Not sent' with Retry
Can a member change their own sign-in address, or only an Admin?
Nobody in phase 1; an Owner does it later
Two people create a channel with the same name at the same moment.
The second gets '#name already exists' with a button to open it (already in the chart; confirm)
Does previewing a public channel without joining count for its unread or Activity?
No; a preview leaves no trace
A batch of invitations fails halfway (the mail server goes down after 3 of 10). Keep the 3, or undo all?
Keep them; each row reports its own result
Should the first load have a size limit for very large workspaces (how many conversations come with `GET /bootstrap`)?
All of them in phase 1; revisit past 500 conversations
What does the invitation refusal page say, and does it tell the causes apart?

Three messages. **Expired:** 'This invitation expired on 12 Nov. Ask Minh to send a new one.' **Revoked:** 'This invitation is no longer valid. Ask an admin of Hugepig Studio for a new one.' **Unknown or damaged link:** 'This link is not valid.', with no workspace name. An invitation already used goes to the sign-in page with the email filled in. No page has a sign-in button for a stranger.

The prototype's code screen has no Resend, only 'Use a different email'. G5 already expects a Resend button after 60 seconds. Is Resend added to the screen, and does a new code cancel the earlier one?
Yes: 'Resend code' under the field, greyed with a countdown for 60 seconds. A new code cancels the earlier one, so only the newest mail works.
The welcome step after accepting an invitation is not in the prototype. Is it wanted, and with which fields?
One screen: display name (required, 1 to 80, filled from the address), job title (optional), time zone (from the device). 'Enter Toki' and 'Skip'.
#general exists before anyone is invited and every newcomer is in it (G1). Does #general show a line when someone joins, and does that line notify anyone?

Yes: a grey system line 'Minh joined', with the date. It raises no unread count and no notification. The prototype has no system lines; its sample shows a person writing 'Welcome Jordan to the team!'.
**Your finding:** the prototype has no '+' for a new channel, only '+ Browse channels', and Browse channels has nothing to create one. Where does 'Create channel' live?

(a) A 'Create channel' button at the top of Browse channels, a 'Create channel' command in Ctrl+K, and 'Create #text' when a search finds nothing · (b) A separate '+' beside the Conversations heading. Suggested: (a), as written flow F20 says.
Which fields does the Create channel dialog have, and what are their limits?
Name (rule G7), Private switch (off by default), Topic (optional, up to 250 characters), Add people (optional). Written flow F20 has 'add members'; the chart leaves it out until you confirm.

Can an Owner or Admin remove a member from any channel? Decided so far (G14): no, only from a channel they belong to, and never from #general. Does that stand, and can the creator of a channel remove people too?
Keep G14. The creator has no extra right. The removed person gets an Activity item 'Lan removed you from #name'; the channel shows 'Lan removed Minh'. This flow has no chart yet.
How does a person choose several people for a group DM? The prototype's New message dialog opens a conversation on the first press.
Each press adds the person as a chip in the field; a 'Start' button opens the conversation. One chip plus Enter opens the DM. Channels in the list still open at once. Limit stays 8 with you (Q17).
The prototype shows 'Waiting to send' and nothing for a send that failed. Where do 'Not sent', Retry and Delete appear?
In the same place as 'Waiting to send', beside the time: a red 'Not sent' followed by two text buttons, Retry and Delete. The message stays faded. Delete asks nothing, since nobody else has seen it.

The prototype's offline banner reads 'Offline: showing saved messages'. Written flow F37 said 'Reconnecting…' and a 'Reconnected' toast, which the prototype does not have. Which wording, and is there a separate reconnecting state?

(a) Keep the prototype's banner the whole time; it disappears when the connection is back, with no toast · (b) Same banner, plus the words 'Reconnecting…' during each try · (c) Replace it by 'Reconnecting…'. Suggested: (a). Until answered the charts use (a) (FA-17).

maps.caption: Happy path runs down the middle; every refusal returns to a screen where the person can act.||Luồng chính chạy dọc ở giữa; mọi lần bị từ chối đều quay về một màn hình mà người dùng làm tiếp được.
notes: **Before:** the address belongs to an active member; this device has no valid session.||**Trước:** địa chỉ thuộc về một thành viên đang hoạt động; thiết bị này chưa có phiên hợp lệ.

**After:** a 30-day session on this device only; the code can never be used again; the app opens where the person was heading.||**Sau:** một phiên 30 ngày chỉ trên thiết bị này; mã không dùng lại được; ứng dụng mở đúng nơi người dùng định tới.

**Validation:** email must look like an address before the button enables. Code: exactly 6 digits, one use. Valid 10 minutes and cancelled after 5 wrong tries are assumptions (FA-13, FA-14). At most 5 code requests per address in 15 minutes (G5).||**Kiểm tra:** email phải đúng dạng thì nút mới bật. Mã: đúng 6 số, dùng một lần. Hiệu lực 10 phút và huỷ sau 5 lần sai là giả định (FA-13, FA-14). Tối đa 5 lần xin mã cho một địa chỉ trong 15 phút (G5).

**Back / cancel / retry:** 'Use a different email' returns to the email field. 'Resend code' enables after 60 seconds. A network failure re-enables the button with 'Could not connect'.||**Quay lại / huỷ / thử lại:** 'Use a different email' quay về ô email. 'Resend code' bật sau 60 giây. Lỗi mạng thì nút bấm lại được, kèm 'Could not connect'.

**Alternative:** the mail also has a sign-in button. Pressing it signs in the device where it is pressed and skips typing the code.||**Nhánh khác:** mail còn có nút đăng nhập. Bấm nút thì thiết bị bấm được đăng nhập, không cần gõ mã.

**Security rule:** the answer to a code request is identical for members and strangers, so the page never reveals who is a member.||**Quy tắc bảo mật:** câu trả lời cho yêu cầu xin mã giống hệt nhau với thành viên và người lạ, nên trang không bao giờ lộ ai là thành viên.

**In the prototype:** No member sign-in. The nearest screens are the guest portal's: 'Sign in as a guest' (email, 'Email me a code') and 'Check your email' (6-digit field, 'Sign in', 'Use a different email', 'It works for 10 minutes'). That screen has **no Resend**, no limit on requests and no wrong-code state (any 6 digits work). Its two errors show in a red line under the card.||**Trong prototype:** Không có đăng nhập cho thành viên. Màn hình gần nhất là của cổng guest: 'Sign in as a guest' (email, 'Email me a code') và 'Check your email' (ô 6 số, 'Sign in', 'Use a different email', 'It works for 10 minutes'). Màn hình đó **không có Resend**, không giới hạn số lần xin mã và không có trạng thái sai mã (6 số nào cũng được). Hai lỗi của nó hiện ở một dòng đỏ dưới thẻ.

**Rule:** a conversation is marked read only when its newest message is on screen and the tab has focus. Opening it in a background tab changes nothing.||**Quy tắc:** chỉ đánh dấu đã đọc khi tin mới nhất nằm trên màn hình và tab đang được focus. Mở ở tab nền thì không đổi gì.

**Older messages:** scrolling up loads 50 more with a spinner at the top and keeps the scroll position; at the start a 'Beginning of #name' marker shows.||**Tin cũ hơn:** cuộn lên thì tải thêm 50 tin, có vòng quay ở trên và giữ nguyên vị trí cuộn; tới đầu thì hiện mốc 'Beginning of #name'.

**Load failure:** the message area shows 'Couldn't load messages' with Retry; the sidebar keeps working (flow 3.3).||**Tải lỗi:** vùng tin nhắn hiện 'Couldn't load messages' kèm Retry; sidebar vẫn dùng được (flow 3.3).

**Preview:** a public channel the person has not joined is readable; the composer is replaced by a Join button.||**Xem trước:** kênh công khai chưa tham gia vẫn đọc được; ô soạn tin được thay bằng nút Join.

**In the prototype:** Home: the conversation list, the message list, unread badges and the 'New' divider exist. There is no loading state and no failure state.||**Trong prototype:** Home: danh sách cuộc trò chuyện, danh sách tin nhắn, huy hiệu chưa đọc và vạch 'New' có trong prototype. Không có trạng thái đang tải và trạng thái lỗi.

sources.title: Sources||Nguồn
items: What marks a channel as read on Web and Phone, and when does the New divider clear? (OQ3)||Điều gì đánh dấu channel đã đọc trên Web và Phone, và vạch New biến mất khi nào? (OQ3)

Answer: Read state never depends on AI. A conversation is read when it is open, the window is in use, and the person is at the bottom of the list. The New divider anchors to the first unread message at the time of opening (by ID, so it does not drift), stays while viewing, and is gone the next time the conversation opens. Opening the app or a conversation with unread messages scrolls to the divider.||Trả lời: Đã đọc không phụ thuộc AI. Hội thoại được đánh dấu đã đọc khi nó đang mở, cửa sổ đang được dùng, và người dùng đã ở cuối danh sách tin. Vạch New neo vào tin chưa đọc đầu tiên tại lúc mở (theo ID, không trôi khi có tin mới), giữ nguyên trong lúc đang xem, và biến mất ở lần mở kế tiếp. Mở app hoặc mở hội thoại có tin chưa đọc thì cuộn tới vạch New.
Does a sender see who has read a message? (G15)||Người gửi có biết ai đã đọc tin không? (G15)
You confirmed: Toki has no 'seen' receipts; a sender does not know who has read a message.||Bạn đã xác nhận: Toki không có dấu “đã xem” cho tin nhắn; người gửi không biết ai đã đọc.

What do people who join a channel later see of its history, and what happens to a channel that is no longer used? (Q27)||Người vào kênh sau thấy được gì trong lịch sử, và kênh không dùng nữa thì xử lý ra sao? (Q27)
You chose the recommended option: Full history; channels are archived, never deleted||Bạn chọn phương án được đề xuất: Thấy toàn bộ lịch sử; lưu trữ được, không xóa hẳn

**Rule NR8** (made from GAP-29, 31, 33): Every searchable or filterable list has an empty state centred in the content area and written for that context. A count on a chip always equals the rows shown.||**Quy tắc NR8** (rút ra từ GAP-29, 31, 33): Mọi danh sách có tìm hoặc lọc đều có trạng thái trống đặt giữa vùng nội dung, viết riêng cho ngữ cảnh đó. Số đếm trên chip luôn khớp với số dòng hiển thị.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-16):** Every screen and every wording in quotes that the prototype does not contain is a proposal: 'Session ended', 'Account deactivated', 'Not found or no access', 'Not sent', 'Can't reach Toki', loading placeholders, and the rest.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-16):** Mọi màn hình và mọi câu chữ trong dấu nháy mà prototype không có đều là đề xuất: 'Session ended', 'Account deactivated', 'Not found or no access', 'Not sent', 'Can't reach Toki', ô giữ chỗ khi tải, và phần còn lại.

maps.title: 2.5 Send a message||2.5 Gửi một tin nhắn
maps.caption: The message shows before the server answers; the same message ID makes a retry safe.||Tin hiện trước khi server trả lời; dùng lại cùng ID khiến việc gửi lại an toàn.
notes: **Before:** a member of the conversation; it is not archived; the composer holds 1 to 10,000 characters or at least one uploaded file.||**Trước:** là thành viên của cuộc trò chuyện; nó chưa bị lưu trữ; ô soạn có từ 1 đến 10.000 ký tự hoặc ít nhất một file đã tải lên.

**After:** one message stored exactly once; every member's unread count rises except the sender's; mentions become Activity items (flow 2.7); the draft is cleared on all devices.||**Sau:** đúng một tin được lưu; số chưa đọc của mọi thành viên tăng, trừ người gửi; mention thành mục Activity (flow 2.7); bản nháp bị xoá trên mọi thiết bị.

**Disabled:** Send does nothing while the text is empty or only spaces, is locked past 10,000 characters (a counter appears near the limit), and while a file is still uploading.||**Bị tắt:** Send không làm gì khi nội dung trống hoặc chỉ có khoảng trắng, bị khoá khi quá 10.000 ký tự (bộ đếm hiện khi gần giới hạn), và khi còn file đang tải lên.

**Keys:** Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a new line; while composing a Vietnamese word, Enter finishes the word and does not send.||**Phím:** Enter gửi, Shift+Enter xuống dòng; khi đang gõ dở một từ tiếng Việt, Enter kết thúc từ chứ không gửi.

**Retry:** 'Not sent' offers Retry and Delete. Retry resends the same ID, so a message that did arrive is never doubled.||**Thử lại:** 'Not sent' có Retry và Delete. Retry gửi lại cùng ID, nên tin đã tới nơi không bao giờ bị nhân đôi.

**Leaving mid-way:** switching conversation before sending keeps the text as a draft, synced to other devices.||**Rời giữa chừng:** chuyển cuộc trò chuyện trước khi gửi thì nội dung thành bản nháp, đồng bộ sang thiết bị khác.

**In the prototype:** The composer and Send exist. With the demo offline switch on, a sent message appears faded with 'Waiting to send'. **'Not sent', Retry and Delete are not in the prototype** (the words do not occur in it), and there is no character counter.||**Trong prototype:** Ô soạn tin và Send có trong prototype. Khi bật công tắc demo offline, tin gửi đi hiện mờ kèm 'Waiting to send'. **'Not sent', Retry và Delete không có trong prototype** (các chữ này không xuất hiện), và không có bộ đếm ký tự.

sources.title: Sources||Nguồn
items: How long may a message be, and how many files may it carry? (G9)||Một tin nhắn dài tối đa bao nhiêu, và kèm được bao nhiêu file? (G9)
You confirmed: A message holds up to 10,000 characters and 10 files.||Bạn đã xác nhận: Một tin tối đa 10.000 ký tự và 10 file.

**Rule NR11** (made from GAP-17 · OQ8): Writing to a conversation (sending, starting a Meet, scheduling) requires membership. Pickers list only conversations you have joined.||**Quy tắc NR11** (rút ra từ GAP-17 · OQ8): Muốn ghi vào một hội thoại (gửi tin, bắt đầu Meet, đặt lịch) phải là thành viên của nó. Danh sách chọn chỉ gồm hội thoại mình đã tham gia.

**Rule NR13** (made from GAP-21 · OQ11): When the connection drops: loaded content stays readable; messages being sent wait and send themselves when the connection returns; every other action is blocked with an explanation, never a false success.||**Quy tắc NR13** (rút ra từ GAP-21 · OQ11): Khi mất kết nối: nội dung đã tải vẫn đọc được; tin đang gửi chuyển sang chờ và tự gửi lại khi có mạng; mọi thao tác khác bị chặn kèm lời giải thích, không báo thành công giả.

**Technical design:** The app creates the message ID, so sending the same message again cannot create a second one.||**Thiết kế kỹ thuật:** Ứng dụng tự tạo ID tin nhắn, nên gửi lại cùng một tin không thể tạo ra tin thứ hai.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-02):** A request with no answer after 10 seconds counts as failed and shows Retry.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-02):** Request không có trả lời sau 10 giây được coi là lỗi và hiện Retry.

maps.title: 2.6 Attach files to a message||2.6 Đính kèm file vào tin nhắn
maps.caption: Bytes go straight to storage; the API only hands out the permission to upload.||Dữ liệu đi thẳng tới kho lưu trữ; API chỉ cấp quyền tải lên.
notes: **Before:** a conversation the person can write to; online (uploading is blocked offline).||**Trước:** một cuộc trò chuyện người dùng được viết vào; đang có mạng (tải lên bị chặn khi mất mạng).

**After:** each file is stored once and attached to the message; it appears in the conversation's 'Files & links' tab and in Files; only people who can see the conversation can open it.||**Sau:** mỗi file được lưu một lần và gắn vào tin nhắn; nó hiện ở tab 'Files & links' của cuộc trò chuyện và ở Files; chỉ người xem được cuộc trò chuyện mới mở được.

**Validation:** at most 10 files per message, 100 MB each. A refused file is named in the message; the others continue.||**Kiểm tra:** tối đa 10 file mỗi tin, mỗi file 100 MB. File bị từ chối được nêu tên trong thông báo; các file khác vẫn tiếp tục.
**Cancel:** × on a card stops that upload and removes the card. Deleting the whole draft removes every card.||**Huỷ:** × trên thẻ dừng việc tải file đó và bỏ thẻ. Xoá cả bản nháp thì bỏ mọi thẻ.

**Loading:** a thumbnail that is not ready shows a placeholder of the right proportions, so the list does not jump.||**Đang tải:** thumbnail chưa sẵn sàng thì hiện ô giữ chỗ đúng tỉ lệ, để danh sách không bị giật.

**In the prototype:** The paperclip in the composer adds a finished sample file at once. There is no file picker, progress bar, limit or failure (finding N-07). The numbers 10 and 100 MB appear nowhere in the prototype.||**Trong prototype:** Icon kẹp giấy ở ô soạn tin thêm ngay một file mẫu đã xong. Không có chọn file, thanh tiến độ, giới hạn hay lỗi (phát hiện N-07). Con số 10 và 100 MB không xuất hiện ở đâu trong prototype.

Pickers list only conversations you have joined.||**Quy tắc NR11** (rút ra từ GAP-17 · OQ8): Muốn ghi vào một hội thoại (gửi tin, bắt đầu Meet, đặt lịch) phải là thành viên của nó. maps.title: 2.7 Being mentioned: from the sender's @ to the recipient reading it||2.7 Được mention: từ dấu @ của người gửi tới lúc người nhận đọc
maps.caption: One mention, three possible ways of being told, depending on the recipient's state.||Một mention, ba cách được báo, tuỳ trạng thái của người nhận.
notes: **Before:** the message was sent (flow 2.5) and contains @person, @channel or @here.||**Trước:** tin đã được gửi (flow 2.5) và có @người, @channel hoặc @here.
**After:** the recipient has one Activity item; it becomes done by itself once the message has been opened.||**Sau:** người nhận có một mục Activity; mục tự thành xong khi tin đã được mở.
**Rule:** your own action never notifies you.||**Quy tắc:** hành động của chính mình không bao giờ tạo thông báo cho mình.

**Rule:** during Pause or Focus there is no toast, push or sound; badges still update, and one summary lists what arrived when it ends.||**Quy tắc:** trong Pause hoặc Focus không có toast, push hay âm thanh; huy hiệu vẫn cập nhật, và khi kết thúc có một bản tóm tắt những gì đã tới.

**Open:** a mention always gets through the 'Mentions only' level. Whether it gets through Mute is not decided (question GQ-01 on the Gap analysis tab); the chart shows the muted case as badge only until it is.||**Còn mở:** mention luôn vượt qua mức 'Mentions only'. Nó có vượt qua Mute hay không thì chưa quyết định (câu hỏi GQ-01 ở tab Phân tích gap); cho tới lúc đó sơ đồ thể hiện trường hợp tắt tiếng là chỉ có huy hiệu.
**Rule:** @channel in a channel of 20 or more people asks the sender to confirm first.||**Quy tắc:** @channel trong kênh từ 20 người trở lên hỏi người gửi xác nhận trước.

**Edit:** adding a mention by editing notifies the new person; removing one removes the earlier notification.||**Sửa:** thêm mention khi sửa tin thì báo cho người mới; bỏ mention thì gỡ thông báo trước đó.

**In the prototype:** The @ button and the people picker are in the composer; Activity lists mentions; Pause and Focus time are in the account menu; Preferences has 'Notify me for @mentions even in muted channels'. Push and the recipient's side cannot be observed: only one person is simulated.||**Trong prototype:** Nút @ và danh sách chọn người nằm ở ô soạn tin; Activity liệt kê mention; Pause và Focus time nằm trong menu tài khoản; Preferences có 'Notify me for @mentions even in muted channels'. Push và phía người nhận không quan sát được: prototype chỉ mô phỏng một người.

items: The prototype has desktop notifications, sound, missed-mention email, per-channel levels, mute, Pause and Focus time. Which of these are in phase 1? (Q16)||Prototype có thông báo desktop, âm thanh, email khi lỡ mention, mức theo kênh, tắt tiếng, Pause và Focus time. Những gì có trong phase 1? (Q16)

You chose the recommended option: Badges, Web Push, sound, per-channel level, mute, Pause, Focus time. Missed-mention email later||Bạn chọn phương án được đề xuất: Badge, Web Push, âm thanh, mức theo channel, mute, Pause, Focus time. Thư báo lỡ mention để sau

**Rule NR5** (made from GAP-20, 26 · OQ10): Your own action never notifies you. An Activity item becomes done on its own once the thing it asks for is done. Activity is newest first and has a filter chip for every kind of item.||**Quy tắc NR5** (rút ra từ GAP-20, 26 · OQ10): Hành động của chính mình không tạo thông báo cho mình. Mục Activity tự chuyển thành đã xong khi việc nó nhắc tới đã được làm. Activity xếp mới nhất trước và có chip lọc cho mọi loại mục.

**Rule NR6** (made from GAP-25, 38 · OQ14): During Pause or Focus time there is no toast, push or sound, including reminders you set yourself. Badges still update. When it ends, one summary lists what arrived. Starting Focus during Focus extends it rather than nesting; ending restores the earlier status.||**Quy tắc NR6** (rút ra từ GAP-25, 38 · OQ14): Trong lúc Pause hoặc Focus time, không có toast, push hay âm thanh nào, kể cả reminder do mình đặt. Badge vẫn cập nhật. Khi kết thúc, hiện một tổng kết những gì đã đến. Bật Focus khi đang Focus thì gia hạn, không lồng; kết thúc thì trả lại status trước đó.
What is the default notification level? (G13)||Mức thông báo mặc định là gì? (G13)
You confirmed: Default notification level: 'Mentions only' for channels, 'All messages' for DMs.||Bạn đã xác nhận: Mặc định mức thông báo: kênh là “Chỉ khi được nhắc”, DM là “Mọi tin nhắn”.
Who may edit a channel's topic and use @channel? (G8)||Ai được sửa chủ đề kênh và dùng @channel? (G8)

You confirmed: Any channel member can edit the topic and use @channel; in a channel of 20 or more people, @channel asks for confirmation first.||Bạn đã xác nhận: Mọi thành viên của kênh sửa được topic và dùng được @channel; kênh từ 20 người thì hỏi xác nhận trước khi gửi @channel.
What does a push notification show? (G11)||Thông báo push hiện những gì? (G11)
You confirmed: A push notification shows the sender, the conversation and the start of the message.||Bạn đã xác nhận: Thông báo đẩy hiện tên người gửi, tên hội thoại và đoạn đầu của tin.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-12):** A mention of someone who is not in the channel creates no notification; the sender is offered 'Add them'.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-12):** Mention một người không ở trong kênh thì không tạo thông báo; người gửi được đề nghị 'Add them'.

**After (join):** member with full history; 'X joined' line in the channel; toast 'Joined #name'.||**Sau (tham gia):** là thành viên với đầy đủ lịch sử; dòng 'X joined' trong kênh; toast 'Joined #name'.

**After (leave):** the channel leaves the sidebar; its unread and Activity items are cleared; 'X left' line in the channel.||**Sau (rời):** kênh rời sidebar; số chưa đọc và mục Activity của nó được xoá; dòng 'X left' trong kênh.

**Rule:** #general cannot be left. A reversible action shows Undo for 5 seconds; an irreversible one asks for confirmation; never both.||**Quy tắc:** không rời được #general. Hành động hoàn tác được thì hiện Undo 5 giây; không hoàn tác được thì hỏi xác nhận; không bao giờ cả hai.

**Empty and archived:** no match shows 'No channels match' and a Create button carrying the search text; archived channels are listed with a View button only.||**Trống và lưu trữ:** không có kết quả thì hiện 'No channels match' và nút Create mang sẵn từ đã tìm; kênh đã lưu trữ chỉ có nút View.

**In the prototype:** Browse channels (search, Join, Open) exists. Leaving is in the Details panel: 'Leave channel', then 'Leave #name? You can rejoin from Browse channels.', then a toast with Undo, for public and private alike (finding N-09). Removing someone else from a channel does not exist.||**Trong prototype:** Browse channels (tìm, Join, Open) có trong prototype. Rời kênh nằm ở panel Details: 'Leave channel', rồi 'Leave #name? You can rejoin from Browse channels.', rồi một toast có Undo, giống nhau cho kênh công khai và riêng tư (phát hiện N-09). Gỡ người khác khỏi kênh thì không có.

items: Which channel does everyone start in, and can it be left? (G1)||Mọi người bắt đầu ở kênh nào, và có rời kênh đó được không? (G1)

You confirmed: Every workspace has a #general channel created at setup; every member is in it automatically; it cannot be left or archived.||Bạn đã xác nhận: Mỗi workspace có kênh #general tạo sẵn; mọi thành viên tự động ở trong đó; không rời và không lưu trữ được.

**Rule NR3** (made from GAP-24 · OQ12): A reversible action happens at once and shows a toast with Undo for 5 seconds. An irreversible action, or one that affects other people, asks for confirmation and names its target. Never both for one action.||**Quy tắc NR3** (rút ra từ GAP-24 · OQ12): Hành động hoàn tác được thì làm ngay và hiện toast có nút Hoàn tác trong 5 giây. Hành động không hoàn tác được hoặc ảnh hưởng người khác thì hỏi xác nhận, nêu rõ đối tượng. Không dùng cả hai cho một hành động.
After leaving a private channel, can a member rejoin alone or do they need an invitation? (OQ2)||Rời channel riêng tư rồi thì tự vào lại hay cần lời mời mới? (OQ2)

Answer: A member must invite them back. The leave confirmation says so; Undo is still offered for 5 seconds. Private channels never appear in Browse or Ctrl+K for outsiders. If the last member leaves, the channel is archived.||Trả lời: Cần một thành viên mời lại. Lời xác nhận khi rời nói rõ điều đó; vẫn có Hoàn tác trong 5 giây. Channel riêng tư không xuất hiện trong Browse hay Ctrl+K với người ngoài. Nếu người cuối cùng rời đi, channel được lưu trữ.

What do people who join a channel later see of its history, and what happens to a channel that is no longer used? (Q27)||Người vào kênh sau thấy được gì trong lịch sử, và kênh không dùng nữa thì xử lý ra sao? (Q27)
You chose the recommended option: Full history; channels are archived, never deleted||Bạn chọn phương án được đề xuất: Thấy toàn bộ lịch sử; lưu trữ được, không xóa hẳn
Do Admins and Owners see and manage every conversation? (G14)||Admin và Owner có thấy và quản lý mọi cuộc trò chuyện không? (G14)

You confirmed: Admins and Owners do not automatically see private channels or DMs; deleting messages, removing people and archiving apply only where they are members.||Bạn đã xác nhận: Admin và Owner không tự động thấy kênh riêng tư hay DM; quyền xóa tin, gỡ người, lưu trữ chỉ áp dụng ở nơi họ là thành viên.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-10):** Leaving a channel clears its unread count and its open Activity items for that person.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-10):** Rời một kênh thì xoá số chưa đọc và các mục Activity còn mở của kênh đó với người rời.

maps.title: 2.10 Edit or delete your own message||2.10 Sửa hoặc xoá tin nhắn của mình
maps.caption: Edit is free and quiet; delete is permanent, so it asks.||Sửa thì tự do và lặng lẽ; xoá là vĩnh viễn nên phải hỏi.
notes: **Before:** the person is the author and the message is not deleted. There is no time limit.||**Trước:** người dùng là tác giả và tin chưa bị xoá. Không giới hạn thời gian.
**After (edit):** new text with '(edited)' beside the time; no history of earlier versions is kept.||**Sau (sửa):** nội dung mới kèm '(edited)' cạnh giờ; không lưu lịch sử các bản trước.

**After (delete):** gone for everyone; attached files are removed from storage and from Files. A message with replies leaves a 'Message deleted' line and keeps its thread.||**Sau (xoá):** biến mất với mọi người; file đính kèm bị gỡ khỏi kho và khỏi Files. Tin có trả lời để lại dòng 'Message deleted' và giữ thread.

**Cancel:** Esc or Cancel leaves the message untouched. Save is disabled while the text is unchanged; saving an empty text offers Delete instead.||**Huỷ:** Esc hoặc Cancel giữ nguyên tin. Save tắt khi nội dung chưa đổi; lưu nội dung trống thì chuyển sang đề nghị Delete.

**Others:** Admins and Owners can delete other people's messages only in conversations they belong to; the author is told.||**Người khác:** Admin và Owner chỉ xoá được tin của người khác trong cuộc trò chuyện mà họ là thành viên; tác giả được báo.

**In the prototype:** The More menu on your own message has Edit and Delete. Edit turns the text into a field with Save and Cancel and adds '(edited)'. Deleting a message with a thread removes every reply in the prototype.||**Trong prototype:** Menu More trên tin của mình có Edit và Delete. Edit biến nội dung thành ô nhập có Save và Cancel, rồi thêm '(edited)'. Trong prototype, xoá một tin có thread thì xoá luôn mọi trả lời.

items: The prototype holds 14 feature groups. Which of them must be in the first release? (Q2)||Prototype có 14 nhóm tính năng. Những nhóm nào bắt buộc có trong bản đầu tiên? (Q2)

You chose the recommended option: Core chat, Activity, Later, Files, People, Preferences, command palette||Bạn chọn phương án được đề xuất: Chat lõi, Activity, Later, Files, People, Preferences, command palette

**Rule NR7** (made from GAP-12, 13, 16, 38): Dates and times: required fields cannot be left empty; where a future time is needed the past is rejected; the year is shown whenever it is not the current year; one format across the app; 'Invalid Date' never appears.||**Quy tắc NR7** (rút ra từ GAP-12, 13, 16, 38): Ngày giờ: trường bắt buộc thì không cho bỏ trống; nơi cần thời điểm tương lai thì từ chối quá khứ; luôn hiện năm khi khác năm hiện tại; một định dạng thống nhất toàn app; không bao giờ hiện "Invalid Date".

**Rule NR6** (made from GAP-25, 38 · OQ14): During Pause or Focus time there is no toast, push or sound, including reminders you set yourself. Badges still update. When it ends, one summary lists what arrived. Starting Focus during Focus extends it rather than nesting; ending restores the earlier status.||**Quy tắc NR6** (rút ra từ GAP-25, 38 · OQ14): Trong lúc Pause hoặc Focus time, không có toast, push hay âm thanh nào, kể cả reminder do mình đặt. Badge vẫn cập nhật. Khi kết thúc, hiện một tổng kết những gì đã đến. Bật Focus khi đang Focus thì gia hạn, không lồng; kết thúc thì trả lại status trước đó.

**Rule NR8** (made from GAP-29, 31, 33): Every searchable or filterable list has an empty state centred in the content area and written for that context. A count on a chip always equals the rows shown.||**Quy tắc NR8** (rút ra từ GAP-29, 31, 33): Mọi danh sách có tìm hoặc lọc đều có trạng thái trống đặt giữa vùng nội dung, viết riêng cho ngữ cảnh đó. Số đếm trên chip luôn khớp với số dòng hiển thị.

**Authorization:** checked on the server for every admin request; hiding the menu item is not the check.||**Phân quyền:** kiểm tra ở server cho mọi request admin; việc ẩn mục menu không phải là kiểm tra.

**Row actions:** Resend sends a fresh link and restarts the 7 days; Revoke asks for confirmation and kills the old link at once.||**Thao tác trên hàng:** Resend gửi link mới và tính lại 7 ngày; Revoke hỏi xác nhận và vô hiệu link cũ ngay.
**Mail down:** the row says 'Mail not sent' and the server command for emergency access still works.||**Mail hỏng:** hàng ghi 'Mail not sent' và lệnh server cho truy cập khẩn cấp vẫn dùng được.

**In the prototype:** **Not in the prototype.** Admin (the shield in the left navigation) has two tabs, analytics and automations; there is no members table and no invitation for members (finding N-02). The only invitation dialog is 'Invite a client' for guests.||**Trong prototype:** **Không có trong prototype.** Admin (icon khiên ở thanh điều hướng trái) có hai tab, thống kê và automation; không có bảng thành viên và không có lời mời cho thành viên (phát hiện N-02). Hộp thoại mời duy nhất là 'Invite a client' cho guest.

You confirmed: An invitation expires after 7 days. The link in the invitation signs the person in directly, without a code.||Bạn đã xác nhận: Lời mời hết hạn sau 7 ngày. Link trong thư mời đăng nhập thẳng, không cần mã.

maps.caption: The effect reaches the other person's screen at once, without a new sign-in.||Hiệu lực tới màn hình của người kia ngay, không cần đăng nhập lại.
notes: **Before:** signed in as Admin or Owner, on the Admin page.||**Trước:** đã đăng nhập với vai trò Admin hoặc Owner, ở trang Admin.

**Who may do what:** only an Owner changes roles. An Admin deactivates Members; only an Owner deactivates Admins and Owners.||**Ai được làm gì:** chỉ Owner đổi vai trò. Admin vô hiệu hoá Member; chỉ Owner vô hiệu hoá Admin và Owner.
**Constraints:** nobody deactivates themselves; the last Owner cannot be demoted or deactivated.||**Ràng buộc:** không ai tự vô hiệu hoá mình; Owner cuối cùng không thể bị hạ vai trò hay vô hiệu hoá.

**After (role):** the label updates on Admin, People and the profile; the person gets an Activity item and sees the Admin entry appear or disappear.||**Sau (vai trò):** nhãn cập nhật ở Admin, People và hồ sơ; người đó nhận một mục Activity và thấy mục Admin xuất hiện hoặc biến mất.

**After (deactivate):** every session ends; old messages stay with a 'Deactivated' label; the person leaves People, mention lists and add-people lists; DMs with them become read-only. Reactivate restores access to the same channels.||**Sau (vô hiệu hoá):** mọi phiên kết thúc; tin cũ vẫn còn kèm nhãn 'Deactivated'; người đó rời People, danh sách mention và danh sách thêm người; DM với họ thành chỉ đọc. Reactivate trả lại quyền vào đúng các kênh cũ.
**Cancel:** closing the confirmation changes nothing.||**Huỷ:** đóng hộp xác nhận thì không có gì thay đổi.

**In the prototype:** **Not in the prototype.** Admin has no members table, so there is no role menu and no Deactivate (finding N-02). People and the profile panel show a role label, read-only.||**Trong prototype:** **Không có trong prototype.** Admin không có bảng thành viên, nên không có menu vai trò và không có Deactivate (phát hiện N-02). People và panel hồ sơ có hiện nhãn vai trò, chỉ đọc.

An irreversible action, or one that affects other people, asks for confirmation and names its target. **Limit:** a group holds at most 8 people, counting the person who starts it. Nobody can be added or removed later; a different set of people is a new group.||**Giới hạn:** một nhóm tối đa 8 người, tính cả người tạo. Về sau không thêm hay bớt người được; một tập người khác là một nhóm mới.

**Same people, same conversation:** choosing a set of people that already has a conversation reopens it with its history.||**Cùng người, cùng cuộc trò chuyện:** chọn một tập người đã có cuộc trò chuyện thì mở lại nó kèm lịch sử.

**Deactivated person:** not listed in the picker; an existing DM with them stays readable, without a composer.||**Người đã bị vô hiệu hoá:** không có trong danh sách chọn; DM đã có với họ vẫn đọc được, không có ô soạn tin.

**In the prototype:** 'New message' is the pencil icon above the conversation list. Its dialog has one field, 'Search people and channels'; pressing a row opens that DM or channel at once. **Several people cannot be chosen**, so a group cannot be started. One group exists as sample data only: 'Alex, Thu', three people.||**Trong prototype:** 'New message' là icon bút phía trên danh sách cuộc trò chuyện. Hộp thoại có một ô, 'Search people and channels'; bấm một hàng thì mở ngay DM hoặc kênh đó. **Không chọn được nhiều người**, nên không tạo được nhóm. Chỉ có một nhóm trong dữ liệu mẫu: 'Alex, Thu', ba người.

maps.title: 3.1 The connection drops and returns||3.1 Mất kết nối rồi có lại
maps.caption: Nothing is lost and nothing is faked.||Không mất gì và không giả vờ thành công.
notes: **Rule:** loaded content stays readable; messages being sent wait and send themselves; every other action is blocked with an explanation, never a false success.||**Quy tắc:** nội dung đã tải vẫn đọc được; tin đang gửi thì chờ và tự gửi; mọi hành động khác bị chặn kèm giải thích, không bao giờ báo thành công giả.

**Catch-up:** the app remembers the number of the last event it saw and asks for everything after it. After more than 7 days away it reloads everything instead.||**Bắt kịp:** ứng dụng nhớ số của event cuối cùng đã thấy và xin mọi thứ sau đó. Vắng hơn 7 ngày thì tải lại toàn bộ.
**No duplicates:** a waiting message is resent with its original ID.||**Không trùng:** tin đang chờ được gửi lại với đúng ID ban đầu.
**Banner:** it never covers the composer or the navigation.||**Banner:** không bao giờ che ô soạn tin hay thanh điều hướng.

**In the prototype:** A demo switch turns the network off. The prototype then shows a strip above the chat, 'Offline: showing saved messages · messages you send wait until you are back online', the same words above the conversation list, and 'Waiting to send' on messages. **'Reconnecting…' and 'Reconnected' are not in the prototype**, and other actions are not blocked (GAP-21).||**Trong prototype:** Một công tắc demo tắt mạng. Khi đó prototype hiện một dải phía trên khung chat, 'Offline: showing saved messages · messages you send wait until you are back online', cùng câu đó phía trên danh sách cuộc trò chuyện, và 'Waiting to send' trên tin nhắn. **'Reconnecting…' và 'Reconnected' không có trong prototype**, và các thao tác khác không bị chặn (GAP-21).

sources.title: Sources||Nguồn
items: **Rule NR13** (made from GAP-21 · OQ11): When the connection drops: loaded content stays readable; messages being sent wait and send themselves when the connection returns; every other action is blocked with an explanation, never a false success.||**Quy tắc NR13** (rút ra từ GAP-21 · OQ11): Khi mất kết nối: nội dung đã tải vẫn đọc được; tin đang gửi chuyển sang chờ và tự gửi lại khi có mạng; mọi thao tác khác bị chặn kèm lời giải thích, không báo thành công giả.

**Rule NR12** (made from GAP-03, 11): Toasts and floating bars never cover the composer or navigation.||**Quy tắc NR12** (rút ra từ GAP-03, 11): Toast và thanh nổi không bao giờ che composer hay nút điều hướng.

**Technical design:** Every change is a numbered event. After reconnecting, the app asks for everything after the last number it saw; after more than 7 days away it reloads.||**Thiết kế kỹ thuật:** Mọi thay đổi là một event có đánh số. Khi kết nối lại, ứng dụng xin mọi thứ sau số cuối cùng nó đã thấy; vắng hơn 7 ngày thì tải lại toàn bộ.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-06):** Reconnect attempts wait 1, 2, 5, 10 and then 30 seconds, with a little randomness.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-06):** Các lần kết nối lại chờ 1, 2, 5, 10 rồi 30 giây, có thêm chút ngẫu nhiên.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-09):** A 'Waiting to send' message survives a page reload, kept in the browser, and is dropped if someone else signs in on that browser.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-09):** Tin 'Waiting to send' vẫn còn sau khi tải lại trang, được giữ trong trình duyệt, và bị bỏ nếu người khác đăng nhập trên trình duyệt đó.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-17):** While offline the banner keeps the prototype's words, 'Offline: showing saved messages'. A separate 'Reconnecting…' state is not assumed.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-17):** Khi mất mạng, banner giữ câu chữ của prototype, 'Offline: showing saved messages'. Không giả định có trạng thái 'Reconnecting…' riêng.

notes: **Before:** the app is open with a session that has just stopped being valid.||**Trước:** ứng dụng đang mở với một phiên vừa hết hợp lệ.

**After:** nothing of the workspace stays readable on screen; after signing in again the person is back in the same conversation with the draft still in the composer.||**Sau:** không nội dung nào của workspace còn đọc được trên màn hình; đăng nhập lại thì người dùng về đúng cuộc trò chuyện, bản nháp vẫn trong ô soạn.

**Rule:** the server checks the session on every request and closes the realtime connection the moment a session ends.||**Quy tắc:** server kiểm tra phiên ở mọi request và đóng kết nối realtime ngay khi phiên kết thúc.
**Rule:** a deactivated account gets no sign-in button, and its locally kept drafts are cleared.||**Quy tắc:** tài khoản bị vô hiệu hoá không có nút đăng nhập, và bản nháp lưu trên máy bị xoá.

**In the prototype:** **Not in the prototype.** It has no sign-in and no sessions, so none of these screens exist (finding N-01).||**Trong prototype:** **Không có trong prototype.** Prototype không có đăng nhập và không có phiên, nên không màn hình nào ở đây tồn tại (phát hiện N-01).

You chose the recommended option: As in the capability table under Roles & States||Bạn chọn phương án được đề xuất: Như bảng quyền ở mục Phạm vi

**Technical design:** The server checks the session on every request and closes the live connection the moment a session ends.||**Thiết kế kỹ thuật:** Server kiểm tra phiên ở mọi request và đóng kết nối trực tiếp ngay khi phiên kết thúc.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-09):** A 'Waiting to send' message survives a page reload, kept in the browser, and is dropped if someone else signs in on that browser.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-09):** Tin 'Waiting to send' vẫn còn sau khi tải lại trang, được giữ trong trình duyệt, và bị bỏ nếu người khác đăng nhập trên trình duyệt đó.

**Assumed, not confirmed (FA-16):** Every screen and every wording in quotes that the prototype does not contain is a proposal: 'Session ended', 'Account deactivated', 'Not found or no access', 'Not sent', 'Can't reach Toki', loading placeholders, and the rest.||**Giả định, chưa xác nhận (FA-16):** Mọi màn hình và mọi câu chữ trong dấu nháy mà prototype không có đều là đề xuất: 'Session ended', 'Account deactivated', 'Not found or no access', 'Not sent', 'Can't reach Toki', ô giữ chỗ khi tải, và phần còn lại.
